description: AI-optimized web search — returns synthesized answer + curated results with extracted page content and relevance scores. Built for LLM/agent RAG pipelines. Supports domain filtering and recency (Tavily)

days.description: Recency filter — only include results from the last N days

include_answer.description: Include AI-synthesized answer based on search results (default true)

include_domains.description: Only include results from these domains (e.g. ["wikipedia.org", "arxiv.org"])

max_results.description: Number of results to return (default 5, max 20)

query.description: Search query — Tavily returns AI-synthesized answer + curated results with extracted content

search_depth.description: Search depth: "basic" (faster, 1 credit) or "advanced" (deeper, 2 credits). Default: basic

name: search.ai.web

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: AI Web Search (Tavily)
